title: Midnight Havana events
description: The event dates shown on the website. Editors change this file by hand; a future admin interface would write the same shape.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, so an editor offers autocomplete and flags mistakes.

_readme.description: Note for whoever edits this file. Ignored by the build.

_readmeFields.description: Per-field notes for whoever edits this file. Ignored by the build.

events.description: One entry per date, in any order. The build sorts them and drops anything in the past.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, Berlin local time. Must be a real date and must not repeat within the file.

slug.description: The last part of the detail page URL, for example al-son-de-cuba. Lower case letters, digits and hyphens. Do not change it after the page is published, or existing links break.

title.description: Name of this edition. Without one, the page shows the date instead.

summary.description: One sentence. Used on the date card and as the meta description of the detail page, so keep it under about 155 characters.

description.description: Two to four sentences for the detail page.

dj.description: Who is playing the social dance.

teachers.description: Who is teaching that night. Shown on the detail page and listed as performers in the structured data.

badges.description: Short labels on the date card, for example a special or a guest DJ.

image.description: File name inside src/assets/photos/ for the large image on the detail page.

flyer.description: File name inside src/assets/flyers/ for the poster.

priceNote.description: Only fill this in when prices differ from the usual ones that night.

cancelled.description: Keeps the date visible but marks it as cancelled.

bookingLinks.description: The Eversports booking links for this date, one per class. Eversports gives every date its own URLs, so they are entered here by hand for each date. Add "party" only when the night itself is bookable. A class with no link falls back to the studio's general Eversports page, and the build names it in the log.

extras.description: Anything on top of the usual four classes, for example a workshop before them.

extra.description: A one-off item in the timetable for a single date.

startTime.description: Start time on a 24 hour clock, for example 17:00.

endTime.description: End time on a 24 hour clock. Optional.

level.description: Level shorthand shown as a badge, for example A2 or B1.

tone.description: gold is neutral, green marks a rueda or son special, solid is the strongest emphasis.

localisedText.description: The same text in both site languages. Both are required so no page falls back to the wrong language.

imageFileName.description: An image file name with its extension, no folders.

bookingUrl.description: An https link on a booking platform we work with. Other hosts are rejected at build time, so a wrong entry can never send visitors somewhere unexpected.
